additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0406040-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R9 170002746] QR code not working CRM:01811000665
additional_info.body:
Hi Tanja,
I hope this message finds you well.
According to the ERK compatibility guidelines, the authentication methods must only include RFID, PIN, or credit card. Adding QR code authentication keys would result in an ERK-incompatible charger. Please refer to the screenshot below for your reference.
If you still wish to add a QR code to unit
170002746
, kindly provide the QR code URL details. For your convenience, I have included the QR code URLs for unit
170002745
below. Please provide the QR code URL for unit
170002746
in the same format, so we can proceed with the addition.
For unit
170002745
, the QR codes are as follows:
Outlet1:
https://virtagermany.charge.virtaglobal.com/stations/261542
Outlet2:
https://virtagermany.charge.virtaglobal.com/stations/261543
Outlet3:
https://virtagermany.charge.virtaglobal.com/stations/261544
Outlet4: vhttps://virtagermany.charge.virtaglobal.com/stations/269207
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
